example.en: There is little doubt that digital automation will improve long-term warehouse productivity.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，數位自動化將會顯著提升倉儲物流的長期生產力。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考肯定強烈片語：without a doubt / little doubt (毫無疑問)。

example.en: Local retailers face intense market competition from multinational online e-commerce platforms.
example.zh: 在地實體零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台極為激烈的市場競爭。

words.mnemonic: 市場抗衡詞彙：stiff competition / fierce competition (激烈競爭)。

example.en: The seminar presenter explained how management theory applies to modern distributed remote teams.
example.zh: 研討會主講人深入闡釋了管理學理論如何具體應用於現代分散式遠距團隊。

words.mnemonic: 理論與實務對比：in theory (理論上)、in practice (實務上)。

example.en: The financial director will formally propose a revised capital expenditure plan at tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 財務總監將在明天的會議上正式提出一份修訂後的資本支出方案。

words.mnemonic: 商務提案核心動詞：propose a plan (提出方案)；衍生名詞 proposal (提案書)。

example.en: Job applicants are required to furnish at least two professional employment references.
example.zh: 求職應徵者依規定須提供至少兩位專業前雇主推薦人名單。

words.mnemonic: 求職推薦與編號查證：reference letter (推薦信)、reference number (參照編號)。

example.en: The consultant presented a compelling financial argument in favor of upgrading to cloud servers.
example.zh: 顧問提出了一項令人信服的財務論據，力挺全面升級為雲端伺服器。

words.mnemonic: 支持提案論點：compelling argument (令人信服的論據)。

example.en: The trade exhibition entrance fee is twenty dollars for adults and complimentary for children.
example.zh: 該商貿展覽會入場費成人為二十美元，兒童則免費招待。

words.mnemonic: 票價費率分類：adult fare (成人票價)、adult passenger (成年旅客)。

example.en: Corporate business executives frequently fly commercial business class on transatlantic routes.
example.zh: 企業高階主管在跨大西洋航線上經常搭乘商業商務艙飛行出差。

words.mnemonic: 航空出差動詞：frequent flyer (飛行常客)、fly direct (搭直航班機)。

example.en: Market analysts identified a noticeable shift in consumer purchasing patterns over the holiday period.
example.zh: 市場分析師在節慶期間發現了消費者購物模式型態的顯著轉變。

words.mnemonic: 市場行為分析：spending patterns (消費型態/消費模式)。

example.en: Job candidates must submit their completed employment application online before Friday.
example.zh: 求職候選人必須在週五前於線上提交填寫完畢的應徵求職申請表。

words.mnemonic: 求職與行動軟體必考：job application (求職申請)、mobile application (手機應用程式)。

example.en: Customers seeking immediate technical assistance may dial our twenty-four-hour telephone hotline.
example.zh: 尋求即時技術協助的客戶可隨時撥打我們的二十四小時電話諮詢熱線。

words.mnemonic: 客服電話必考：telephone hotline (諮詢熱線)、hot item (熱銷商品)。

example.en: Upgrading automated equipment obviously helped our factory increase daily manufacturing throughput.
example.zh: 升級自動化設備顯然幫助了我們的工廠提高每日製造產量吞吐。

words.mnemonic: 顯而易見副詞：obviously true (顯而易見屬實)。

example.en: If any instructions on the assembly diagram remain unclear, contact the support supervisor.
example.zh: 若組裝圖解上的任何說明指示依然不明確，請立即聯絡支援主管。

words.mnemonic: 字首 un- 反義詞：clear (清楚) -> unclear (不清楚/不明朗)。

example.en: Hotel guests may review their finalized itemized room bill at the front desk prior to departure.
example.zh: 飯店房客在退房出發前可於接待櫃檯審閱其最終的逐項客房費用帳單。

words.mnemonic: 飯店退房與帳務出帳：itemized bill (明細帳單)、utility bill (水電費帳單)。

example.en: Users can search our online electronic archives by keyword or document identification number.
example.zh: 使用者可以透過關鍵字或文件身分編號檢索我們的線上電子檔案庫。

words.mnemonic: 人資獵才與線上搜尋：executive search (高階主管獵才)、search engine (搜尋引擎)。

example.en: Please submit travel lodging receipts and client meal expenses on separate reimbursement forms.
example.zh: 請將差旅住宿收據與客戶餐費支出分別填寫在各自獨立的報銷申請表上。

words.mnemonic: 分開報帳與個別處理：separate forms (各自獨立的表格)、separate cover (另函寄送)。
roots: par 準備 → 分開安排

example.en: The corporate headquarters is situated in a prominent central location adjacent to the subway.
example.zh: 企業總部位於緊鄰捷運站的地標精華核心地段。

words.mnemonic: 選址核心詞：central location (黃金核心位置)、central office (總辦公室)。

example.en: The enterprise actively supports ongoing professional development and employee career advancement.
example.zh: 該企業積極支持持續專業在職進修與員工職涯升遷發展。

words.mnemonic: 招募網站專區：career opportunities (職涯機會)、career fair (就業博覽會)。

example.en: Although the budget estimate was preliminary, the committee decided to proceed with the bid anyway.
example.zh: 儘管預算估算僅為初步性質，委員會依然決定無論如何都要推進該項投標。

words.mnemonic: 語氣轉折副詞：anyway = regardless (無論如何)。

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring keynote speech at the annual international trade banquet.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度國際商貿晚宴上發表了鼓舞人心的主題演講。

words.mnemonic: 演講動詞搭配：give a speech / deliver a speech (發表演說)。

example.en: The luxury hotel allows certified guide dogs to accompany guests inside all dining and lodging areas.
example.zh: 該豪華飯店允許經認證的導盲犬陪同房客進入所有餐飲與住宿區域。

words.mnemonic: 飯店無障礙規定：guide dog (導盲犬)、service dog (服務犬)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the finalized annual auditing report to the board of directors.
example.zh: 財務長向董事會正式呈報了最終年度審計報告。

words.mnemonic: 高階主管頭銜縮寫必背：CEO (執行長)、CFO (財務長)、security officer (保全專員)。

example.en: Complimentary wireless internet connectivity is accessible throughout the entire conference center.
example.zh: 全體會議中心全區內部均可連線使用免費無線網路。

words.mnemonic: 遍及範圍與整段時間：throughout the year (全年)、throughout the building (遍及整座大樓)。

example.en: Factory maintenance mechanics regularly check lubricating oil levels across all production machines.
example.zh: 工廠維護技師定期檢查所有生產機具的潤滑機油液位。

words.mnemonic: 設備潤滑與能源：crude oil (原油)、oil change (換機油)。

example.en: All corporate employees are required to adhere to business professional dress code guidelines.
example.zh: 所有企業員工皆必須遵守商務專業服儀規範準則。

words.mnemonic: 公司人事規範大考點：dress code (服儀規定)、business casual dress (商務休閒服裝)。

example.en: The business reported a higher profit.
example.zh: 公司本季度實現了豐厚的利潤。

words.mnemonic: 收入扣除成本後的錢。
roots: fit 做 → 向前的成果

example.en: I guess we should reconfirm tomorrow's conference room booking with the administrative secretary.
example.zh: 我想我們應該跟行政秘書再次確認明天會議室的預訂登記情況。

words.mnemonic: 口語聽力委婉表達：I guess so (我想也是)、take a guess (猜猜看)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness committee organized a fun weekend retreat for staff and families.
example.zh: 企業員工健康委員會為同仁及眷屬籌辦了一次充滿樂趣的週末研習營。

words.mnemonic: 員工聯誼活動描寫：have fun (玩得開心)、fun activity (有趣的活動)。

example.en: Factory employees must wear specialized protective helmets and boots to protect against workplace injury.
example.zh: 工廠員工必須穿戴專用防護頭盔與防護鞋靴以防範職場工傷意外。

words.mnemonic: 資安與工安核心動詞：protect against (防範/抵禦)、protect data (保護資料)。
roots: tect 覆蓋 → 擋在前面遮蓋

example.en: The corporate human resources division oversees employee recruitment, benefits, and staff training.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部門負責督導員工招募、福利與同仁培訓進修。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的部門：human resources (HR, 人力資源部)。
roots: source 湧出 (surgere) → 再度湧現的來源

example.en: Our pharmaceutical research laboratory applies cutting-edge medical science to vaccine development.
example.zh: 我們的製藥研發實驗室將尖端醫學科技應用於疫苗開發。

words.mnemonic: 高科技研發名詞：computer science (資訊科學)、science park (科學園區)。

example.en: The corporate health insurance package provides full diagnostic coverage for chronic disease treatments.
example.zh: 企業健康保險套裝福利針對慢性疾病的診療提供全面的給付保障。

words.mnemonic: 健保福利與防疫：prevent disease (預防疾病)、infectious disease (傳染病)。

example.en: Please ensure that the remaining account balance is fully settled before the end of the billing cycle.
example.zh: 請確保帳戶剩餘應付結餘款在該出帳週期結束前全額結清。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會與人事兩大王牌：account balance (帳戶餘額)、work-life balance (工作與生活平衡)。

example.en: Customers should inspect delivered packages immediately and report any transit damage to the courier.
example.zh: 顧客在貨物送達時應立即檢查包裹，並向快遞公司回報任何運送損壞。

words.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：cause damage (造成損壞)、damaged goods (受損商品)。

example.en: Our facility security team conducts preventative equipment maintenance checks on a daily basis.
example.zh: 我們的廠房保全維護團隊每日定期進行預防性設備檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 多益超級頻率片語：on a daily basis (每天)、on a regular basis (定期)。

example.en: The keynote speaker is a distinguished author of several bestselling management strategy handbooks.
example.zh: 特邀主講嘉賓是數本暢銷管理策略實務手冊的知名作家作者。

words.mnemonic: 出版品作者：lead author (主要作者)、book author (圖書作家)。

example.en: All newly hired administrative assistants must demonstrate basic proficiency in spreadsheet applications.
example.zh: 所有新進行政助理皆必須展現操作試算表應用軟體的基本熟練能力。

words.mnemonic: 入門要求：basic skills (基本技能)、basic salary (底薪)。

example.en: Corporate leadership encourages staff members to pursue ongoing professional education and certification.
example.zh: 企業領導層大力鼓勵同仁攻讀持續專業進修課程並考取專業證照。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：encourage someone to do something (鼓勵某人做某事)。

example.en: Factory operators working on food processing lines must wear protective hairnets at all times.
example.zh: 在食品加工流水線上作業的工廠員工在任何時候皆必須配戴防護髮網。

words.mnemonic: 食品安全工安規章：hair net (髮網)。

example.en: Company employment policies strictly enforce equal opportunities for male and female job applicants.
example.zh: 公司就業政策嚴格落實對男女求職應徵者一律平等的就業機會。

words.mnemonic: 性別平權招募用語：male and female (男性與女性)。

example.en: A designated client services manager will get in touch with you before the end of the day.
example.zh: 專屬客戶服務經理將在今天結束前回覆聯絡您。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益通訊超級核心片語：get in touch with / keep in touch (保持聯繫)。

example.en: Passengers whose luggage was misplaced should file an official lost baggage report immediately.
example.zh: 行李遺失的旅客應立即向櫃檯提出正式遺失行李申報單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公歸檔與提報申請：file a claim (提出索賠)、file a report (提交報告)。

example.en: Business travelers booking flights online generally prefer aisle seats over middle seats.
example.zh: 線上訂票的商務旅客通常比起中間座位更偏好走道座位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 座位與組織階層：middle seat (中間座位)、middle management (中階管理層)。

example.en: Executive hotel guests enjoy access to the rooftop cocktail bar and panoramic observation deck.
example.zh: 行政客房貴賓可享用頂樓調酒酒吧與全景觀景台設施。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店休閒設施與條碼：snack bar (點心吧)、bar code (條碼)。

example.en: The regional airline suffered substantial operating losses due to prolonged airport runway closures.
example.zh: 由於機場跑道長時間關閉，這家區域航空公司遭受了嚴重的營業虧損。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 蒙受虧損搭配：suffer losses (遭受虧損)、suffer damage (受損)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee formulated an ambitious marketing strategy to expand into Europe.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會制定了一項進軍歐洲市場的雄心勃勃的行銷策略。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商管必備高頻詞：marketing strategy (行銷策略)、business strategy (商業策略)。

example.en: Our consulting firm provides deep analytical insights into global supply chain logistics.
example.zh: 我們的管理顧問公司針對全球供應鏈物流提供深入的分析洞察。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 深度分析與巨額折扣：deep discount (大幅折扣)、deep understanding (深入理解)。

example.en: The downtown customer service branch is open daily except on official public holidays.
example.zh: 市中心客戶服務門市每日照常營業，唯國定假日除外。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 例外排除介系詞：except for (除了...之外)。
roots: cept 拿 → 拿出去、除外

example.en: Hotel housekeeping staff clean and restock all guest accommodations between ten and two.
example.zh: 飯店房務人員於上午十點至下午兩點之間清掃並補充所有客房用品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 房務與環保科技：clean energy (潔淨能源)、housekeeping cleans rooms (房務人員清潔客房)。

example.en: Consumers tend to purchase more electronic goods during promotional holiday sale events.
example.zh: 消費者在節慶促銷特賣活動期間往往會採購更多的電子商品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 趨勢與習慣動詞：tend to do something (往往/傾向於做某事)。

example.en: Business travelers are strongly advised to reserve hotel accommodations at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 強烈建議商務旅客至少提前兩週預訂飯店住宿。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：in advance (事先/提前)、advance notice (事先通知)。

example.en: All job applicants must fill out the online background information form before the interview.
example.zh: 所有應徵者在面試前皆必須填妥線上背景資料表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行政填表與徵才兩大王牌片語：fill out a form (填表)、fill a vacancy (填補職缺)。

example.en: The convention delegation stayed at an internationally recognized five-star waterfront hotel.
example.zh: 會議代表團入住了一家享譽國際的五星級濱水大飯店。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店評等專有名詞：five-star hotel (五星級飯店)。

example.en: Attending the annual trade banquet offers an invaluable opportunity to network with industry peers.
example.zh: 出席年度商貿晚宴為與業界同儕建立專業人脈提供了難能可貴的機會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人脈建立與資訊科技：networking event (人脈交流活動)、computer network (電腦網路)。

example.en: Corporate board meetings are generally conducted on the third Wednesday of each calendar month.
example.zh: 企業董事會會議一般在每個月的第三個星期三定期召開。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 日常慣例副詞：generally speaking (一般而言)。

example.en: The corporation streamlined its European manufacturing operations to reduce logistics overhead.
example.zh: 該企業精簡了其歐洲製造營運體系以降低物流經常性開支。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 運營與開銷名詞：hours of operation (營業時間)、operating costs (營運成本)。

example.en: Our downtown department store promises to match any lower advertised price from local competitors.
example.zh: 我們的市中心百貨門市承諾跟進匹配在地競爭同業所刊登的任何更低價格。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 退款保證與核對：price match (跟進買貴退差價)、match the description (與描述相符)。

example.en: Drivers should take alternative bypass routes to avoid heavy construction traffic on the highway.
example.zh: 駕駛人應當走替代外環路線以避開高速公路上的嚴重施工車潮。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文法考點：avoid 後面一律接「V-ing」或名詞！(avoid making mistakes)。
roots: void 空 → 使空出、避開

example.en: Passengers may reserve their preferred aisle or window seat during online flight check-in.
example.zh: 旅客在線上辦理登機報到時可預訂其偏好的走道或靠窗座位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票劃位必考：aisle seat (走道座位)、window seat (靠窗座位)。

example.en: Please do not throw away confidential client documents; use the locked disposal bins instead.
example.zh: 請勿隨意丟棄機密客戶文件；請改為投入上鎖的碎紙回收箱內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 廢棄物處理片語：throw away (丟棄)、throw a party (辦派對)。

example.en: The project supervisor assigned specific administrative tasks to each member of the engineering team.
example.zh: 專案主管將具體的行政任務指派給工程團隊的每位成員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公指派搭配：assign a task (指派任務)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: Following the scheduled software maintenance, normal online banking operations will resume at eight.
example.zh: 在定時的軟體維護完畢後，正常的線上網銀營運將於八點整恢復。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 正常營運狀態：normal business hours (正常營業時間)、back to normal (恢復正常)。

example.en: The corporate sales team reached its quarterly revenue goal two weeks ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 企業銷售團隊提前兩週順利達成了其季度營收目標。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業達標動詞搭配：reach a goal / achieve a goal (達成目標)。

example.en: The customer care associate assisted the client with processing an expedited warranty claim.
example.zh: 客戶關懷專員協助該客戶辦理了快捷保固理賠申報手續。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職稱大考點：sales associate (業務專員)、associate manager (副經理)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant is hiring skilled blue-collar workers for the new robotic assembly line.
example.zh: 這家製造廠正為其全新的機器人組裝流水線招募技術熟練的藍領工人。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益勞力族群考點：blue-collar worker (藍領勞工)、blueprint (工程藍圖)。

example.en: Our newly launched eco-friendly product line received overwhelmingly positive customer reviews.
example.zh: 我們新上市的環保產品系列獲得了廣大顧客壓倒性正面的好評肯定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評價肯定詞：positive feedback (正面回饋)、positive attitude (積極態度)。
roots: -itive 形容詞 → 明確放定的

example.en: Customers can choose a payment option.
example.zh: 我們目前正在評估三種不同的選項。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可選擇的項目。

example.en: All fragile ceramic items must be packed securely inside reinforced cardboard shipping boxes.
example.zh: 所有易碎陶瓷商品均必須妥善加固包裝在加厚瓦楞運送紙箱內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流郵政名詞：cardboard box (瓦楞紙箱)、PO Box (郵政信箱)。

example.en: The promotional flash discount campaign proved to be a huge commercial success for the retailer.
example.zh: 這場快閃促銷折扣活動被證明為該零售商帶來了巨大的商業成功。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 巨大的商業成果：huge success (巨大成功)、huge difference (巨大差異)。

example.en: Please leave a detailed message with the receptionist if the account executive is away from his desk.
example.zh: 若客戶主管不在座位前，請在接待員處留下詳細留言訊息。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電話留言核心搭配：leave a message (留言)、take a message (記錄留言)。
reviewWords.roots: miss 送 → 被送出的訊息

example.en: The senior consultant cited several successful instances of digital cloud enterprise transformation.
example.zh: 資深顧問列舉了數個成功的企業數位雲端轉型實例。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀舉例最愛考片語：for instance = for example (例如)。
roots: stan 站 → 站在眼前的事例

example.en: The manager's open and collaborative leadership style boosted team morale and overall productivity.
example.zh: 經理開明且強調協同合作的領導風格大幅提升了團隊士氣與整體生產力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 領導風格與時尚款式：leadership style (領導風格)、out of style (過時)。

example.en: Please refer to the attached PDF diagram for complete step-by-step equipment assembly instructions.
example.zh: 請參閱隨附之 PDF 圖解，以獲得完整的設備組裝逐步指南說明。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公文指示必背片語：refer to (參閱/參考)、refer a candidate (推薦求職者)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 帶回去參照

example.en: Our sales team prefers inbound digital marketing strategies rather than making unsolicited cold calls.
example.zh: 我們的銷售團隊偏好集客式數位行銷策略，而非進行未經預約的陌生電訪推銷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 業務推銷大考點：cold call (陌生開發電訪)、cold weather (寒冷天候)。

example.en: The retail marketing department launched an intensive push to promote seasonal clearance apparel.
example.zh: 零售行銷部門發動了一場強力的促銷推進宣傳，以推廣出清換季特賣服飾。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷推進名詞/動詞：make a push for (大力推廣)、push the deadline (推遲截止日)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the third quarter earnings results during the board meeting.
example.zh: 財務長在董事會會議上報告了第三季度的盈餘業績。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財會最核心名詞：first quarter / Q1 (第一季)、quarterly report (季度報告)。

example.en: Ms. Carter will officially assume the role of chief executive officer starting next Monday.
example.zh: 卡特女士將於下週一正式承擔就任執行長一職。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益就職必考搭配：assume the role of / assume responsibility (承擔職責)。

example.en: The luxury resort hotel provides complimentary baby cribs and stroller rentals upon request.
example.zh: 這間豪華度假飯店應房客要求免費提供嬰兒嬰兒床與手推車租賃服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務與育嬰設施：baby crib (嬰兒床)、baby-sitting (代客托嬰照料)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee commended the marketing team for a highly successful product rollout.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會讚揚了行銷團隊新產品推廣上市的圓滿大獲成功。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 成功成果形容詞：successful candidate (錄取者/成功的應徵者)。

example.en: A celebrated regional vocal choir was invited to sing at the annual corporate charity gala.
example.zh: 一家知名的區域人聲合唱團獲邀在年度企業慈善晚會上獻唱表演。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 宴會娛樂活動描寫：sing at the gala (在晚會上演唱)。

example.en: The international flight from Tokyo is scheduled to arrive at terminal two on time.
example.zh: 來自東京的國際班機預定準時抵達第二航廈。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通準點高頻搭配：arrive on time (準時抵達)、arrive at the airport (抵達機場)。

example.en: Customer care representatives should remain patient and polite when addressing billing complaints.
example.zh: 客戶關懷專員在處理帳單申訴時應始終保持耐心與禮貌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服品質形容詞：be patient with (對...有耐心)。

example.en: Under current company financial guidelines, travel entertainment expenditures require prior approval.
example.zh: 依據目前的企業財務規範，差旅應酬支出皆需事先報准。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 當前狀態指標詞：current position (現職)、current market conditions (當前市場行情)。

example.en: The manufacturing enterprise celebrated over a century of precision engineering innovation.
example.zh: 該製造企業慶祝了其在精密工程創新領域走過一個多世紀的輝煌歷程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 百年老店品牌宣傳常用：over a century of excellence (百年卓越)。

example.en: The audit committee found clear documentary evidence of accounting compliance across all subsidiaries.
example.zh: 審計委員會在所有子公司中皆發現了符合會計合規規範的明確文件證據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：clear evidence (明確證據)、evidence to support (支持...的證據)。
roots: vid 看 → 看得出來的證據

example.en: Strict regulatory safeguards exist to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive client databases.
example.zh: 現行制度中存在著嚴格的監管防護機制，以防止敏感客戶資料庫遭到未授權存取。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 存在動詞，衍生名詞 existence (存在)、形容詞 existing (現有的)。
roots: sist 站 → 站出來存在

example.en: Our new smartphone model delivers performance features similar to those of competitor devices.
example.zh: 我們的新款智慧型手機機型提供與競爭對手機型相仿的性能特點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比較規格必考片語：similar to (與...相似)。

example.en: Retail businesses must fight aggressively to maintain their market presence against online competitors.
example.zh: 實體零售商家必須積極奮戰，以對抗線上競爭對手並保住市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市場抗衡比喻用語：fight for market share (爭奪市占率)。

example.en: Our enterprise is recognized as a global industry leader in renewable clean energy technology.
example.zh: 我們企業獲公認為全球再生乾淨能源科技領域的產業龍頭。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業地位經典搭配：industry leader (產業龍頭)、market leader (市場領導者)。

example.en: Drivers who fail to display a valid parking permit will be subject to a fifty-dollar fine.
example.zh: 未出示有效停車許可證的駕駛將會被處以五十美元的罰款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞「罰款」pay a fine；形容詞「精細的」fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: Our flagship retail store is centrally located across the street from the subway station.
example.zh: 我們的旗艦零售門市位於捷運站正對面的街角黃金地段。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 地址方位必備：across the street (在街對面)、on the street (在街上)。

example.en: The keynote address was delivered by the former president of the national trade association.
example.zh: 開幕主題演講由前任全國商貿協會會長親自發表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人事異動與履歷常見：former employee (前任員工)、the former (前者)。

example.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team if you require additional information.
example.zh: 若您需要進一步資訊，請隨時與我們的客戶支援團隊聯繫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益書信結尾最標準動詞：contact us (與我們聯絡)、contact person (聯絡窗口)。

example.en: The new ergonomic office chairs are particularly comfortable during long working hours.
example.zh: 這款全新人體工學辦公椅在長時間工作期間格外舒適耐坐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 程度副詞，強調特定優點：particularly useful (格外有用)。

example.en: Corporate employees may extend healthcare insurance coverage to their husband or wife.
example.zh: 企業員工得將其醫療健康保險保障範圍擴大涵蓋其配偶夫或妻。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工家庭福利條款常見詞彙：spouse (配偶) 或 husband and wife。

example.en: The corporate employee recreation club sponsors annual amateur sport leagues for staff members.
example.zh: 企業員工育樂社團每年為同仁資助籌辦業餘體育聯賽。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 休閒福利與零售：sporting goods (體育用品)、sports club (體育俱樂部)。

example.en: Department heads will meet tomorrow morning to discuss the quarterly expenditure budget.
example.zh: 部門主管將於明天上午會面以商討季度支出預算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 及物動詞，後面直接接受詞！千萬不要加 about (discuss the plan)。
roots: cuss 搖、敲 → 拆開討論

example.en: Our support center guarantees an email response within twenty-four hours of receiving an inquiry.
example.zh: 我們的客服支援中心保證在收到洽詢後的二十四小時內給予電子郵件答覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公文必考搭配：in response to (為了回應...)、quick response (快速回覆)。

example.en: Please leave a detailed message on my corporate voicemail if I am away from my desk.
example.zh: 若我不在辦公座位前，請在我的企業語音信箱中留下詳細留言。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室通訊必考字：voicemail (語音信箱)、voice mail message (語音留言)。

example.en: The facility manager ordered several new pieces of ergonomic office equipment for staff.
example.zh: 廠房主管為員工訂購了數件全新的人體工學辦公設備器材。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞大考點：a piece of advice (一則建議)、a piece of equipment (一件設備)。

example.en: The engineering team worked overtime to finish the software upgrade ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 工程團隊加班趕工以提前完成軟體系統升級作業。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工作完工動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：finish doing something。

example.en: All employees are supposed to wear their photo identification badges inside the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內部均應當配戴其照片身分識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場規章必考句型：be supposed to + 原形動詞 (理應/應該要)。
roots: pos 放置 → 放在下面假設

example.en: Interested candidates should apply online before the official submission deadline on Friday.
example.zh: 有興趣的應徵者應在週五官方截止日期前完成線上求職申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益兩大王牌搭配：apply for a job (應徵工作)、apply to (適用於)。
roots: ply 折、貼 → 貼向、申請

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring opening address at the annual trade summit.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度商貿高峰會上發表了鼓舞人心的開幕致詞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高階管理層職稱：vice president (副總裁/副總)、company president (公司總裁)。

example.en: All factory workers must participate in the mandatory building fire safety evacuation drill.
example.zh: 所有工廠員工皆必須參與大樓強制性的消防安全疏散演習。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工安演習名詞：fire drill (消防演習)、fire alarm (火災警報器)。

example.en: Corporate sales increased by eighteen percent compared to the same period last year.
example.zh: 企業銷售額與去年同期相比增長了百分之十八。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考分詞片語：compared to / compared with (與...相比)。
roots: par 相等 → 放一起比

example.en: Shopping mall visitors can enjoy a wide variety of meals in the third-floor food court.
example.zh: 購物中心訪客可在三樓美食街享用各式各樣的餐飲美食。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商場與商務情境常客：food court (美食街)、take to court (提告)。

example.en: Airport police officers patrol passenger terminal concourses around the clock for safety.
example.zh: 機場警官全天候在客運航廈大廳巡邏以確保旅客安全。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 維安保全用語：police officer (警官)、police department (警察局)。

example.en: Our new flagship department store will open its doors to retail shoppers next Friday.
example.zh: 我們全新的旗艦百貨門市將於下週五正式開門迎接零售購物顧客。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重用法：名詞「零售店」retail store；動詞「存放資料」store data。

example.en: The manufacturing plant replaced the aging conveyor belt due to poor operational efficiency.
example.zh: 由於運作效率低落不佳，製造廠更換了老化的輸送帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 品質評估反面詞：poor quality (劣質)、poor condition (狀況不佳)。

example.en: The technical support position requires sound practical knowledge of cloud networking systems.
example.zh: 該技術支援職位需要具備紮實的雲端網路系統實務知識。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷要求詞彙：working knowledge of (對...具備實務知識)。

example.en: The motivational speaker shared humorous industry anecdotes that made the audience laugh.
example.zh: 激勵演講大師分享了幽默的產業趣聞，引得現場觀眾開懷大笑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 社交會場氣氛描寫詞：make people laugh (引人發笑)。

example.en: Factory operators upgraded the robotic welding arm to improve manufacturing precision.
example.zh: 工廠作業員升級了自動化機械焊接手臂以提高製造精度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工廠自動化與家具配件：robotic arm (機械手臂)、armchair (單人扶手椅)。

example.en: Our boutique corporate hotel is conveniently situated in the very heart of the financial district.
example.zh: 我們的精品商務飯店坐落於金融商業區最繁華的正中心核心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 地理位置黃金片語：in the heart of (在...的正中心)。

example.en: Our restaurant chain partners with certified organic farms to source fresh culinary ingredients.
example.zh: 我們的連鎖餐廳與合格有機農場合作，以採購新鮮的烹飪食材原料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購與能源來源：source of revenue (營收來源)、renewable energy source (再生能源)。

example.en: Every employee receives an identification card.
example.zh: 每位員工都有一張識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: employ 的人。

example.en: The senior project director will manage cross-departmental coordination for the new rollout.
example.zh: 資深專案總監將主導管理新產品推展的跨部門協調工作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 管理核心動詞：manage a project (管理專案)、manage to do (設法辦成)。

example.en: To subscribe to our monthly newsletter, simply enter your email address into our web portal.
example.zh: 欲訂閱我們的每月電子通訊刊物，只需在我們的網站入口輸入您的電子郵件地址即可。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷操作指示句首詞：Simply call / Simply visit (只需致電/只需造訪)。

example.en: Clients can settle corporate consulting invoices via electronic commercial bank transfers.
example.zh: 客戶可透過電子商業銀行轉帳方式結清企業顧問諮詢費發票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 金融機構必考：bank account (銀行帳戶)、bank statement (對帳單)。

example.en: Our international consulting firm specializes in cross-border corporate mergers and acquisitions.
example.zh: 我們的國際顧問事務所專門提供跨國企業併購與重組顧問服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專業機構常用名詞：law firm (律師事務所)、accounting firm (會計師事務所)。

example.en: The facility director addressed employee concerns regarding improved ventilation in the workshop.
example.zh: 廠房主管回應了員工對於改善車間通風情況的關切。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益書信開頭常用：To Whom It May Concern (敬啟者)。

example.en: Failure to meet market demand could cause the company to lose valuable market share to rivals.
example.zh: 無法滿足市場需求可能會導致公司將寶貴的市場份額拱手讓給競爭對手。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 虧損與流失搭配：lose money (賠錢)、lose market share (失去市占率)。

example.en: The public relations team crafted an inspiring success story highlighting our client partnership.
example.zh: 公關團隊精心打造了一篇鼓舞人心的成功案例故事，突顯我們與客戶的合作夥伴關係。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公關行銷常用 success story (成功故事)；亦可指建築樓層 (ten-story building)。

example.en: The engineering team has almost completed the functional testing phase of the new machine.
example.zh: 工程團隊已經差不多完成了新機器的功能測試階段。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 進度接近完成用語：almost finished (快完成了)、almost never (幾乎從不)。

example.en: Corporate sales are expected to continue their strong upward trend throughout the coming quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的季度中，企業銷售額將繼續保持強勁的上升趨勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 趨勢與合約延續動詞：continue to grow (持續成長)。
roots: tin 握住 → 連在一起持續

example.en: Company sales representatives will be stationed at our exhibition stand during the trade fair.
example.zh: 在貿易博覽會期間，公司業務代表將進駐我們的展覽攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 展覽攤位名詞：exhibition stand；縮寫代表 stand for。

example.en: The chief executive commended the whole marketing team for their outstanding annual performance.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷團隊在年度的卓越表現。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 強調全員或完整期間：the whole team (整個團隊)、on the whole (整體而言)。

example.en: The final budget proposal has not yet been approved by the corporate finance committee.
example.zh: 最終預算提案尚未獲得企業財務委員會的核准。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：not yet (尚未)，搭配完成式；as yet (迄今)。

example.en: Corporate clients can secure preferential room rates by booking through our travel desk.
example.zh: 企業客戶透過我們的差旅服務台預訂，可鎖定優惠客房費率。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 旅館與金融超核心名詞：room rate (房價)、interest rate (利率)。

example.en: Our customer care center is committed to addressing every client complaint professionally.
example.zh: 我們的客戶關懷中心致力於專業地處理每一項客戶投訴。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 福利與服務考點：customer care (客戶關懷/客服)、health care (醫療保健)。

example.en: Financial analysts expect company profits to increase substantially over the coming fiscal year.
example.zh: 財務分析師預期公司利潤將在即將到來的會計年度大幅成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：expect to do / expect someone to do (預期...做...)。
roots: spect 看 → 向外看、期待

example.en: The revised parking regulations will take effect starting on the first day of next month.
example.zh: 修訂後的停車管理辦法將自下個月第一天起正式生效。

roots: fect 做 → 做出的結果

example.en: Automated sorting machines sort incoming courier packages by postal destination code.
example.zh: 自動分揀機依據郵遞目的地代碼對進廠快遞包裹進行分類。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流與郵務常考動作：sort packages (將包裹分類)。

example.en: This quarter recorded the highest customer satisfaction score we have ever achieved.
example.zh: 本季度創下了我們歷來所取得的最高客戶滿意度評分。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 最高級強調用語：the best... ever (史上最佳)。

example.en: Please let the support desk know if there is anything else we can do to assist you.
example.zh: 若有任何其他我們能為您提供協助的事項，請告知支援服務台。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服客氣詢問結尾句：Is there anything else I can help you with?

example.en: A power surge in the electrical grid caused a temporary shutdown of the assembly line.
example.zh: 電網中的電湧導致了組裝線的暫時停工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 故障原因分析核心詞：cause a delay (導致延遲)。

example.en: Raw material costs are projected to fall by five percent over the upcoming autumn quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的秋季，原料成本將下降百分之五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 指標下降動詞：prices fall (價格下跌)；亦可指秋季 (in the fall)。

example.en: Our purchasing director succeeded in closing a major supply deal with the overseas manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們的採購總監成功與海外製造商敲定了一筆重大供應協議。
